indexSelectionWithoutAggregation.sql: SELECT id,label FROM Item WHERE price>=? AND price<? ORDER BY price
beforePlan: USE TEMP B-TREE FOR ORDER BY
afterPlan: SEARCH Item USING INDEX ix_price (price>? AND price<?)
indexSelectionWithoutAggregation.selection: B-tree supports ordered range search; equality-only hash has no direct ordered range operation.
indexSelectionWithoutAggregation.observation: Index choice and cost tradeoff can be reasoned about without grouping or aggregate-function competence; this is exactly the old full goal and T31 topic.

viewRoleWithoutAggregation.sql: CREATE VIEW PublicItem AS SELECT id,label FROM Item
viewRoleWithoutAggregation.limit: Role policy is an explicit logical permission matrix, not a claim that SQLite supplies role GRANT/REVOKE.

basicAutomatonWithoutHierarchyParallelis.observation: Ordinary state modelling and simulation are possible without composite or orthogonal states. Basic FSM authority does not itself establish an unavoidable hierarchy/parallelism gap.
